releaseNotes: Adds Basement Auto Puzzles: levers, poster collection and keypad submission from server-provided codes, picture tile alignment, and finite color-counter search. Optional puzzle teleport/aim pauses conflicting farm actions. Waits for server acknowledgement, backs off on failures, and restores camera on disable/unload. Color clue images are not decoded; color solving uses controlled combination search. Includes real Luau compilation and planner unit tests.
